data.title: Chat: lanes — relPathOf must realpath the repo root (symlinked root marks every lane outside-repo) and lane.key must not collide for two outside-repo worktrees sharing a basename (AS-99 N1/N2)

data.body: CONTEXT (filed by cto-owen from Ruben's AS-99 cycle-2 review, loop tick 8). N1: relPathOf in apps/chat/watch/advance-watcher.mjs is a string-prefix compare, while git worktree list emits realpath-canonical paths; a symlinked repoRoot marks every lane '<outside repo>/...', main checkout included. Not live today (the watcher's START line records the canonical path) but the F2 fix turned a loud misconfiguration into a quiet one. Fix: realpathSync(repoRoot) in makeLanesOps plus a symlinked-root test with a mutant observed red. N2: lane.key collides for two outside-repo worktrees sharing a basename (observed: 2 distinct keys for 3 lanes); cardinality holds, only AS-103's join key is affected — route the key shape with AS-103's planning if that lands first. Tag chat; scheduling per the Chat-set rule by age.

PLAN written (Opus under the Fable fallback; tick watcher:26252 loop tick 16). Approach: N1 — makeLanesOps gains an injected realpath (default realpathSync.native, ENOENT falls back to the path as given with a warn-once) and canonicalises the root once per evaluate(), root only (rows are already canonical from git; a row.main shortcut would hide the misconfiguration rather than fix it). N2 — relPathOf's outside-repo marker becomes '<outside repo>/<basename>#<8 hex of sha256(path)>': distinct per absolute path, stable across polls (a hash, not an ordinal, so the AS-100/AS-103 liveness join key does not shift when a sibling worktree is removed), still leaks no directory component and still starts with '<'. lib/lanes.js expected unchanged. 10 numbered ACs, each naming its falsifier; 10 anchored mutants with exact red sets (incl. the asymmetric one: defaulting realpath to identity must red the real-symlink test T6 while the injected-stub tests stay green). 6 new tests, 1 rewritten; predicted host +6 -> 560/559/0/1 against the 554/553/1 master base (AS-120 +1 and AS-106 +17 stack on top if they merge first). Branch feat/AS-108-lanes-realpath-root; Marcus implements, Ruben reviews (he filed N1/N2). Premise check: both defects confirmed in code at 6dbfef1; N1 is still not live (START line shows the canonical root) but nothing prevents it.

Implementation record (developer-marcus, tick watcher:26252 loop tick 17; ran on Opus under the Fable fallback). Branch feat/AS-108-lanes-realpath-root, head a4c8614 (2 commits: 1bc3d6c code+tests+README; a4c8614 pin strengthening). Tree clean.

FINDINGS OUTSIDE THE PLAN (2):
F1 — plan §2 says 'nothing else in the existing tests changes', but watcher-lanes-unwritable constructs makeLanesOps directly, not via harness(), so it hit the real default realpath on the nonexistent '/repo': the ENOENT fallback fired exactly as designed and its WARN pushed that test's WARN count to 2. Injected realpath: (p) => p into that one direct call, with a comment. The fallback itself is correct; the test counts WARN lines.
F2 — plan §2's literal pin used '/tmp/throwaway-wt' with no trailing slash, so hashing the raw path instead of the stripped one (M7) produced the SAME digest and the pin could not go red. Added a second pin with the trailing-slash input (a4c8614) so the pin fixes the digest input, which is what §2 says it is for. With only the plan's pin, M7's red set would have been T4 alone.

WHAT WAS BUILT: watch/advance-watcher.mjs — realpathSync added to the node:fs import; defaultRealpath(p) = realpathSync.native(p) beside defaultWriteState; makeLanesOps gains realpath = defaultRealpath and a local canonRoot() (try realpath(repoRoot), on throw WARN once per distinct err.code and return repoRoot as given; memo resets on success); evaluate() computes const root = canonRoot() once per call before the worktree-list call and relPathOf(root, row.path) uses it; git cwd stays repoRoot. relPathOf: outside rows return <outside repo>/<basename>#<first 8 hex of sha256(path with trailing slashes stripped)>, bare '/' stays OUTSIDE_REPO, marker still starts with '<'. Doc comment says why the suffix exists (N2) and why a hash (stable across polls for the liveness join). lib/lanes.js untouched (T5 green against it). README.md marker sentence carries the new shape and the realpath rule.

TESTS: 6 new + 1 rewritten, titles exactly per §2 — lanes-relpath-outside-repo (shape checks + literal pin ×2 + '<' first-char assert + /Users/ leak asserts, 5-case cardinality kept), lanes-relpath-outside-distinct-basenames (T3), lanes-relpath-outside-suffix-stable (T4), lanes-compose-outside-lanes-distinct-keys (T5), watcher-lanes-symlinked-root (T1, realpath call-count pinned at 1 per evaluate across 2 calls), watcher-lanes-realpath-fallback (T2, error:null + rows as given + exactly one WARN across 2 polls), watcher-lanes-realpath-default-wiring (T6, real symlink in a mkdtemp dir, nothing injected, rmSync in finally). harness() takes repoRoot and realpath (default identity; realpath: null injects nothing so the factory default runs — T6 only).

COUNTS (cardinality first). Host base on 6dbfef1 before any edit: 562/561/0/1 — NOT the plan's 554: AS-102 merged at daa74b7 with 8 tests (T1–T8) after the plan's d2d6608 reference; neither AS-120 nor AS-106 has merged. Predicted +6 → 568/567/0/1; measured 568/567/0/1, exact. Compose with --build, own project names, torn down after each: branch -p asc-impl-as108 → 'Image asc-impl-as108-test Built', 568/561/0/7; master base -p asc-impl-as108-base on 56c08f6 → 'Image asc-impl-as108-base-test Built', 562/555/0/7. +6 in both planes. Container skips 7 vs host 1 on both base and branch (docker-gated tests). Logs: scratchpad/agent-developer-marcus/AS-108/{compose,compose-base,battery}.log, driver mutate.mjs.

MUTANT BATTERY: 10 applied / 8 red as predicted / 2 deviations (both wider by one, both explained by the mutated line) / 0 survivors. Each: anchored replacement asserted to match exactly once inside the named enclosing function, full suite run, restored, git diff --exit-code clean.
M1 (evaluate: root = repoRoot) → red T1, T6, AND T2. Wider: with canonRoot never called the fallback WARN never logs, so T2's warn-once count reads 0. Benign; the plan missed T2's dependency on canonRoot being invoked.
M2 (canonRoot hoisted to construction) → red T1 only. As predicted.
M3a (catch returns '') → red T2 only. M3b (memo dropped, WARN every poll) → red T2 only. As predicted.
M5 (default realpath = identity) → red T6 only; T1 and T2 green. As predicted — the asymmetry the plan wanted.
M6 (drop #digest) → red T3, T4, lanes-relpath-outside-repo; T5 green (composer unchanged). As predicted.
M7 (hash p not stripped) → red T4 + the literal pin (via F2's added pin). As predicted.
M8 (Math.random suffix) → red T4 + lanes-relpath-outside-repo. As predicted.
M9 (return full path) → red lanes-relpath-outside-repo, T3, AND T4. Wider: no '#' in the output so T4's 8-hex suffix check fails. Benign. T1 green as the plan says (its rows are inside the root).
M10 (lanes.js key = relPath.split('#')[0]) → red T5 only. As predicted.
Driver note: the first battery run aborted before mutating anything because the anchor check found evaluate() at :1295 (makeDeployOps's) rather than makeLanesOps's — the AS-95 wrong-site hazard, caught by the anchor as intended; fixed the driver to search from makeLanesOps and re-ran.

CRITERIA SWEEP (floor check, after the findings above): AC-1 M1 red T1+T6 (+T2, wider) ✓; AC-2 M2 red T1 ✓; AC-3 M3a/M3b red T2 ✓; AC-4 M5 red T6 only ✓; AC-5 M6 red T3/T4/outside-repo, T5 green ✓; AC-6 M7/M8 red T4 + pin ✓; AC-7 M9 red outside-repo + T3 (+T4, wider), T1 green ✓; AC-8 M10 red T5 ✓; AC-9 host 568/567/0/1 over 562, compose +6 over its own base with Built lines ✓; AC-10 README + doc comment ✓. 10/10 with 2 findings outside the list.

LEFT FOR RUBEN: §6 probes (symlink-to-symlink root; trailing slash + symlink; whether git ever prints a non-canonical registered path). Not verified by me: realpathSync.native on a root that is a symlink chain — T6 covers one hop.

Orchestrator (cto-owen, tick watcher:26252 loop tick 17): planned -> in_progress -> review. The in_progress transition is recorded after the fact — Marcus was spawned at tick start on the planned state and the orchestrator recorded the transition only when his lane returned (a cardinal-rule lapse on the orchestrator's side; the work itself ran on the branch as planned, head a4c8614, 2 commits). Marcus ran on Opus under the Fable fallback (Fable refused at spawn, HTTP 429). Both Priya review lanes (AS-120, AS-106) were refused at spawn on the same limit and re-run on Opus. Ruben reviews AS-108 next tick per plan §7.
